audit_type: Final Independent Production Release Gate Audit

claims_verdict.basis: Deterministic tests (CONC-01..12, IDEM-01..06) prove single-execution guarantee via canonical idempotency keys and transactional operation claims.
claims_verdict.qualification: Requires distributed storage (Firestore/Redis) when running multiple separate container instances.

claims_verdict.basis: 41 core tests + 21 adversarial tests prove LLM output cannot mark outcomes as verified without deterministic tool evidence.

claims_verdict.claim: Policy Engine Superiority & Human Approval Gate
claims_verdict.basis: PolicyEngine rejects unverified actions; authenticated JWT principal stamps approvals, overriding forged body metadata.
20 security tests (AUTH-01..20) exhaustively test signature validation, expiration, role gating, and cross-tenant rejection.
claims_verdict.qualification: Tenant isolation verified on individual workflow lookups; collection list queries must pass tenant filters.

claims_verdict.basis: ResilientGemini centralized rate limiter (>= 6.5s interval, <= 10 RPM), circuit breaker, and UNKNOWN crash state transitions pass 14 unit tests and 7 live Gemini scenarios.
claims_verdict.qualification: Rate limiter is in-process async token queue; multi-replica container deployments require distributed rate limiter.

claims_verdict.basis: StructuredJsonFormatter produces valid JSON with contextvars; recursive redaction masks JWTs, API keys, passwords, and tokens.
GET /metrics produces low-cardinality Prometheus text; GET /api/health and GET /api/ready test liveness and backend dependencies.
ShutdownManager tracks background agent executions, rejects new tasks upon shutdown, and drains active tasks within 5s.
claims_verdict.qualification: External tool calls taking longer than 5s will be cancelled on container SIGKILL.

claims_verdict.basis: WorkflowStore recreation preserves workflows, plans, events, claims, and enforces OCC version conflicts.

claims_verdict.claim: Live Google Cloud Firestore Transactions & Multi-Node OCC
claims_verdict.basis: FirestoreWorkflowStore code is implemented and verified statically, but tests/test_firestore_emulator.py was skipped due to missing local emulator CLI.
claims_verdict.qualification: Requires live Firestore emulator or GCP project connection.

claims_verdict.basis: Dockerfile static contract (non-root appuser, multi-stage build, HEALTHCHECK) is verified, but runtime container launch was unexercised due to inactive local Docker daemon.
claims_verdict.qualification: Requires host with active Docker daemon.

claims_verdict.claim: Zero-Loss Hard Crash Recovery Across All Failure Modes
claims_verdict.basis: Startup reconciler and failure matrix (Scenarios A-P) prove idempotent recovery for supported external tools.
claims_verdict.qualification: Third-party APIs lacking queryable read APIs cannot be reconciled without external transaction logging.

phase_6_authorization: BLOCKED — Phase 6 development must not begin until live Firestore and live Docker runtime verifications are executed.
